The Company may assign this Agreement without consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets. HDI may not assign this Agreement, in whole or in part, without the prior written consent of the Company (which shall not be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of the Company.

input.comment: [Playbook] We confirmed our right to assign to an affiliate or transaction successor without consent and added a consent gate (not unreasonably withheld) on HDI's assignment, with no assignment to our competitors. HDI hosts our site and holds our customer data, so we need to know who stands behind that obligation.
input.summary: Add Company affiliate/successor assignment carve-out and consent requirement on HDI assignment in Section 10.3.
